This page summarizes the current VirMarkDB release and provides visual checks of marker coverage across viral families.

```{r}
#| echo: false

coverage_file <- "data/marker_coverage.tsv"
coverage <- read.delim(coverage_file, check.names = FALSE)
marker_cols <- setdiff(names(coverage), "Family")
family_coverage <- coverage[coverage$Family != "Total genomes", ]
coverage_matrix <- as.matrix(family_coverage[, marker_cols])
rownames(coverage_matrix) <- family_coverage$Family
```

## Release summary

```{r}
#| echo: false

n_markers <- length(marker_cols)
n_families <- nrow(family_coverage)
marker_totals <- as.numeric(coverage[coverage$Family == "Total genomes", marker_cols])
max_marker_total <- max(marker_totals, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_marker_total <- round(mean(marker_totals, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
```

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.vm-card}
<div class="metric">`r n_markers`</div>
<div class="metric-label">marker genes</div>
:::

::: {.vm-card}

:::

::: {.vm-card}

## Genome representation by marker

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
#| echo: false

barplot(
  marker_totals,
  names.arg = marker_cols,
  las = 2,
  ylab = "Number of genomes",
  main = "Genome representation by marker"
)
```

## Coverage heatmap

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
#| echo: false

mat <- coverage_matrix
mat_plot <- t(mat[nrow(mat):1, , drop = FALSE])
par(mar = c(7, 10, 3, 2))
image(
  x = seq_len(ncol(mat_plot)),
  y = seq_len(nrow(mat_plot)),
  z = t(mat_plot),
  axes = FALSE,
  xlab = "Family",
  ylab = "Marker",
  main = "Marker coverage across viral families"
)
axis(1, at = seq_len(ncol(mat_plot)), labels = rev(rownames(mat)), las = 2, cex.axis = 0.7)
axis(2, at = seq_len(nrow(mat_plot)), labels = colnames(mat), las = 2, cex.axis = 0.8)
box()
```

## Marker coverage by family

```{r}
#| echo: false

knitr::kable(coverage, align = c("l", rep("r", length(marker_cols))))
```

::: {.callout-important}
Missing values in the coverage table do not automatically indicate true biological absence. See [About - limitations](about.qmd#notes-and-limitations).
:::

## Phylogenetic diversity

A phylogenetic tree was generated from a concatenated alignment of the eight marker genes. Individual marker alignments were produced with MAFFT, trimmed with TrimAl, concatenated, and used for tree inference with IQ-TREE. Only viruses with at least five retained markers were included in this analysis.

![VirMarkDB phylogenetic tree based on concatenated marker-gene alignments](data/tree_five_markers.png)
